human_annotation.source: User confirmed to Codex; relayed by the coordinating agent.
human_annotation.scope: The 40 newly selected recordings in this session.
human_annotation.limitations: This is not a calibrated noise measurement or an independently recorded quiet/noise comparison.

method.exact_metric: Unmodified full expected-plan equality; no text/payload normalization for scoring.
method.alias_counterfactual: Only one in-memory target alias at a time; original transcripts and expected plans remain unchanged. Two distinct WAVs with strict grammar target boundaries required for a proposal.
method.scope: Read completed saved reports/WAV hashes and run pure parser only. No inference, capture, playback, windows, hotkeys, network, polling or project edits.

limitations: Transcript differences and leading energy do not identify acoustic cause or prove missing spoken words.
Speech-end latency uses the common Silero frame estimate, not manual ground truth. Release latency is a separate distribution.
Multiple recognizers on the same WAV are not independent recordings.
The check label is preserved; usual background noise is a separate human annotation, not a new measured condition.
No backend is selected and no alias is applied by this analysis.
